title: Mode Dock Gap Baseline Overshoot
description: Fix pixel-perfect alignment of the bottom baseline between the last tab and fullscreen button in Mode dock chrome — the horizontal line overshoots on both sides at the L-joint corners.
summary: Fixed Mode dock gap baseline overshoot: the horizontal stroke between the last tab and fullscreen cap now uses an inset `after:border-b` (`inset-x-px`) so it meets the L-joint corners without extending into the tab or controls cap. Added regression assertions on the active stack gap slot.
